conventions.pick_return: dashboard convention: long exit/entry-1, short entry/exit-1
conventions.window: last close on/before signal date -> last close on/before close date
conventions.independence: t_cluster collapses picks sharing one (entry_day, exit_day) window to a single observation; t_stat is the naive per-pick version and overstates significance whenever a strategy fires in batches. t_cluster is null below 5 windows
conventions.hourly_fallback: where the daily benchmark window collapses (entry and exit on the same trading day) the benchmark is taken from Yahoo 60m bars at the last bar at or before each timestamp; unresolved picks stay in window_collapsed and are never scored as zero excess
